detail: R-verify-scope-step-files-takes-commas-doc-4b95: verify --scope step --files takes commas, doc_tests and the skills show spaces

data.title: verify --scope step --files takes commas, doc_tests and the skills show spaces
data.label: KNOWN FACT
data.what: verify --scope step --files 'a.py b.py' passes the whole string as one run_suite.py argument (exit 2 usage, step run 1 of T-2026-10-29-2234); the comma form works. The skills and the doc_tests line are written with spaces, so the first scoped run of a documents-only task is wasted
